purpose: 기억 블록(source artifact)과 채널 뷰(revisioned binding). 샌드박스와 제품 CLI/GUI가 같은 ID 공식·불변식을 쓴다. 검색 실행(WO 06)과는 별개다.

scope_fingerprint.payload: sorted unique block_ids joined by newline, then newline, then decimal revision with no leading zeros

rules: one block is one source_room; Discord guild:channel is never merged into one block
attach/detach must not rewrite block vector or summary files
evidence carries block_id, platform, source_room, and label
recency windows use per-block time anchors; never compare naive kakao times to discord offsets
person_aliases on a block are search hints, not identity merge
